items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Strayhorn wrote an album for Vic Dickenson, but the interviewee (Vic Dickenson) does not speak or confirm any personal relationship with Strayhorn in the provided text.

ctx.x: Well, I think he... I know he loved Duke very much. He sort of knew that he was helping him. As much as he was featured in the band, I always felt that I wanted to hear him more. He made a beautiful album that Strayhorn wrote, when he plays like "Moonlight On The Ganges."
